basic_details.job_title: IIT Jammu Research Associate (Biosciences & Bioengineering) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Research Associate post on the National Technical Textile Mission-funded project "Multicolor, Fluorescent, UV protector and Bactericidal Smart Textile using Carbon Quantum Dots, RP-100371" at Indian Institute of Technology Jammu pays INR 58000 + 16% HRA per month for an initial 12 months, extendable to 1 more year. One post is open to Indian nationals with a Ph.D. in Nanotechnology/Nanomaterials/Biotechnology/Material Science or in any other relevant discipline to the project. Applications are to be uploaded on the online portal apply.iitjammu.ac.in by 22 November 2026.

important_dates.interview_date: To be informed to shortlisted candidates by e-mail

how_to_apply: Go to the online portal https://apply.iitjammu.ac.in/#/home.
Apply through the [contract/project staff/JRF/SRF] tab on the portal.
Upload the duly filled application form with the requested details, scanned copies of certificates and other supporting documents by 22 November 2026.
Upload all documents for educational qualification (10, 12, graduation, post-graduation etc.) and experience.
Upload a list of your research publications under the "Additional Information" section of the online form. This is mandatory.
Give a valid e-mail ID and phone number in the application, since shortlisted candidates are informed by e-mail.
Correspondence address: Dr. Vinay Sharma, Department of Biosciences & Bioengineering, Indian Institute of Technology Jammu, Jagti, NH-44 Nagrota Bypass, Jammu - 181221. Email: [email protected].
important_instructions: The applicant is responsible for the authenticity of the information, documents and photographs submitted. Candidates called for interview should reach IIT Jammu at their own expense. TA/DA is not permissible for an offline interview or for joining if the job is offered. Candidates who are already employed must produce a relieving certificate from their employer if selected. The notice is in English and Hindi. If there is any confusion, the English version is final.

content_sections.heading: About the Institute
content_sections.text: Indian Institute of Technology Jammu is located at Jagti, NH-44, Nagrota, Jammu (Jammu and Kashmir) – 181221. This post is for a research project sanctioned by the National Technical Textile Mission. The notice is dated 09.11.2026, and Dr. Vinay Sharma of the Department of Biosciences & Bioengineering is named for correspondence.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian nationals can apply. The essential qualification is a Ph.D. in Nanotechnology/Nanomaterials/Biotechnology/Material Science or in any other relevant discipline to the project. The candidate should have a consistently good academic record. The desirable qualifications are: Prior experience with Nanomaterial synthesis, Characterization, Bacterial and Mammalian cell culture, Textile applications. An excellent publication record. The upper age limit is 35 years. A relaxation of 5 years is given to SC/ST/OBC/women/physically challenged candidates. The notice prints no date for counting age. Candidates should check the official notification for discipline-specific eligibility.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated salary is INR 58000 + 16% HRA per month, as per NTTM and approved project norms. The post is purely contractual. The initial period is 12 months, extendable to 1 more year based on project need and satisfactory performance. The post is co-terminus with the project.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Jammu Research Associate
content_sections.text: Go to the online portal https://apply.iitjammu.ac.in/#/home . Apply through the [contract/project staff/JRF/SRF] tab on the portal. Upload the duly filled application form with the requested details, scanned copies of certificates and other supporting documents by 22 November 2026. Upload all documents for educational qualification (10, 12, graduation, post-graduation etc.) and experience. Upload a list of your research publications under the "Additional Information" section of the online form. This is mandatory. Give a valid e-mail ID and phone number in the application, since shortlisted candidates are informed by e-mail. Correspondence address: Dr. Vinay Sharma, Department of Biosciences & Bioengineering, Indian Institute of Technology Jammu, Jagti, NH-44 Nagrota Bypass, Jammu - 181221. Email: [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates may be shortlisted based on merit and need for the project. Having the prescribed qualification alone does not ensure a call for interview. Only shortlisted candidates will be called, and they will be informed of the date and time by e-mail. The interview will be held using the online platform. Shortlisted candidates must appear on the interview date with an updated CV and original and attested photocopies of mark sheets/certificates supporting their academic qualifications.

faq.question: Q1. How many Research Associate vacancies are there at IIT Jammu?
faq.answer: There is 1 (one) Research Associate post, on the project funded by the National Technical Textile Mission.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Jammu Research Associate post?
faq.answer: The last date for receiving the duly filled application is 22 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the IIT Jammu Research Associate post?
faq.answer: A Ph.D. in Nanotechnology/Nanomaterials/Biotechnology/Material Science or in any other relevant discipline to the project is required, with a consistently good academic record.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this post?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years. SC/ST/OBC/women/physically challenged candidates get a relaxation of 5 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the Research Associate?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary is INR 58000 + 16% HRA per month, as per NTTM and approved project norms.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for this post?
faq.answer: Upload the application form, certificates and supporting documents on https://apply.iitjammu.ac.in/#/home through the contract/project staff/JRF/SRF tab by 22 November 2026, with the publications list in the Additional Information section.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Candidates may be shortlisted based on merit and need for the project, and shortlisted candidates are interviewed. They are informed by e-mail, and the interview is held using the online platform.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The post is purely contractual, for an initial 12 months, extendable to 1 more year, and is co-terminus with the project.

faq.question: Q9. Is HRA paid on top of the INR 58000 salary?
faq.answer: The notice states the pay as INR 58000 + 16% HRA per month, as per NTTM and approved project norms.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. TA/DA is not permissible for an offline interview or for joining, and candidates must reach IIT Jammu at their own expense.
